column2: He was a little relieved when his old pal, Henry Swanson, finally got on.
It wasn't until he was almost at his floor that he realized the speaker was not playing the usual commercials.
And once again, he was puzzled when he noticed none of the old crowd on the bus.
Never heard of Marlins before today.
All right, save it for me.
He dragged himself into the kitchen where his wife Mary was preparing breakfast and discovered it was still June 15th.
My wife, Mary, doesn't remember a thing.
All right, it's worth the chance.
We can make a run for it down the tunnel.
